newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stock market volumes seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stock market volumes seen rising.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks are seen moving in a narrow range at current levels while turnover is expected to rise as investors react positively to this week's market-friendly budget, brokers said on Friday.
"We feel turnover should start swelling gradually," said Mahendra Jayasekara, general manager of CT Smith Stock Brokers.

The Colombo all share index closed 2.78 points up at 620.67 on Thursday with small local investors in an upbeat mood after Wednesday's budget, which cut public spending and taxes, and gave incentives to industry, including exporters.
Jayasekara said he thought the market would consolidate at current levels.
"Even foreign investors are happy about the incentives offered by the government to the private sector," he said.
The Sri Lanka Chamber of Commerce on Thursday gave full endorsement to the budget package, calling it "realistic" in its effort to remove constraints on investment and development.
